target.name: next_day_simulated_recorded_spo2_below_90
target.rule: At decision day t, predict the next calendar day released simulated SpO2 measurement <90. A missing future measurement or incomplete future horizon has unknown label. Ongoing low readings are included: this is state forecasting, NOT incident exacerbation prediction.
target.threshold_basis: Explicit illustrative measurement threshold; not a validated COPD event definition or treatment rule.

population.selection: First 800 by SHA256(20261017|F24-selection|source_patient_id); selection independent of labels/coverage
population.split: Selected source profiles ordered by SHA256(20261017|F24-split|source_patient_id); disjoint base profile IDs. Existing study split is not reused.
population.independence: New deterministic patient RNG keys, same fictional source profile pool and frozen mechanism; not external or clinical validation.

simulation.primary_reason: A newly declared hypothetical daily-monitoring workflow for a different measured-value target; 85% simulated daily availability. Not a measured TOLIFE service and not a revised result of the old seven-day experiment.

eligibility.missing_input_policy: Training medians plus explicit missing indicators. No future imputation.

features.static: 17 frozen simulator static features from the same fictional EHR profile
features.dynamic: Six current sensor channels; last available values and ages; past-only rolling 3/7/28-day means, prior28 mean/count, last7 counts/std, delta from last prior observation; released dyspnea/cough scores with release age. Never forward-fill future values.

fit.weights: Equal total training weight per profile with eligible labelled rows; mean row weight one
fit.preprocessing: Fit medians, missing indicators and scaling on train only. Stable feature schema includes all 17 static columns.
fit.selection: Highest validation average precision; ties lower validation Brier then candidate declaration order.
fit.calibration: None post-hoc: report probability reliability and Brier honestly. No calibration fitted on test.
fit.threshold: Validation only: maximize F1 among thresholds with recall>=0.60, precision>=0.50 and alert fraction<=0.35. If none, maximize validation F1; still fail demo gates if unsupported.

baselines: two-state current-low transition probabilities fitted on train

test_gate.failure_policy: Publish all results; do not change targets, generator, thresholds or seeds after test. No active predictions in app if gates fail.

metrics: new-low transition diagnostic and ongoing-low distinction
evaluation.static_ablation: Report whether actual incremental benefit from EHR is supported; nominal fusion alone is not proof of benefit.
evaluation.stress: Same held-out base profiles and keyed trajectories with original sparse source-reference monitoring; no threshold refit.

api_policy.raw_model_artifact_no_pickle: Portable numeric JSON; verify identical predictions against fitted sklearn model.
